techniques.label: Word cycler
techniques.desc: AnimatePresence mode='wait' — rotates value props through a single line on interval

techniques.label: Editorial pull quote
techniques.desc: Manual line breaks via display:block spans, 4-step color scale for reading rhythm

techniques.label: GIF illustrations
techniques.desc: Screen recordings → Gifski-compressed GIFs used as feature section visuals

techniques.label: Jumbo wordmark
techniques.desc: 8906px-wide PNG as hero centrepiece — type treated as image

techniques.label: H-scroll masonry
techniques.desc: Mixed portrait/landscape card heights create visual rhythm in draggable row

techniques.label: Bento UI cards
techniques.desc: Fake-but-realistic UI mockups as section illustrations — no icons, no stock photos

techniques.label: Infinite marquee
techniques.desc: Doubled list + single CSS translateX(-50%) keyframe. No library needed.

techniques.label: Drag carousel
techniques.desc: Framer Scroll component set to horizontal — zero JS, native gesture

techniques.label: Depth via fill value
techniques.desc: Slightly lighter bg fills create elevation over dark bg — no box-shadow needed

techniques.label: Micro-illustrations
techniques.desc: Step-process widgets with contextual animated UI previews per step

techniques.label: Corner bracket markers
techniques.desc: L-shaped divs at card corners — 4 absolute-positioned elements, each showing only 2 borders for HUD aesthetic

techniques.label: Glassmorphism cards
techniques.desc: backdrop-filter: blur(20px) + rgba(255,255,255,0.05) bg + 1px border at ~12% opacity

techniques.label: Organic wave chart
techniques.desc: SVG cubic bezier path fills, two overlapping translucent areas for market vs portfolio comparison

techniques.label: Avatar arc network
techniques.desc: Circular avatars positioned along a curved SVG path — simulates a social graph with CSS transforms

techniques.label: Radial dot matrix
techniques.desc: background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 1px, transparent 1px) @ 16px/16px repeat

techniques.label: Icon-first card structure
techniques.desc: Centered icon circle → heading → description → UI illustration. Top-down reading: symbol, concept, proof

techniques.label: SVG connection tree
techniques.desc: Brand logos joined by SVG line paths converging to a single central node — API integration metaphor

techniques.label: Scrolling word cloud
techniques.desc: Vertical/diagonal grid of capability words scrolling behind a centred auth badge

techniques.label: Waveform illustration
techniques.desc: SVG rect bars of varying heights — classic speech/audio visualization pattern

techniques.label: Noise grain texture
techniques.desc: SVG feTurbulence filter or semi-transparent PNG overlay applied to card surfaces

techniques.label: Perspective-tilted product UI
techniques.desc: CSS perspective + rotateX/rotateY on the dashboard screenshot creates the classic 3D product hero tilt

techniques.label: Floating annotation badges
techniques.desc: Pill labels positioned outside the tilted card frame — breaks the box, implies depth

techniques.label: Stacked card scatter
techniques.desc: Multiple overlapping cards at different rotation angles suggest a physical desk of assets

techniques.label: 3D CGI asset renders
techniques.desc: Isometric 3D renders of real-world assets used as category illustrations — not photos

techniques.label: Soft lavender gradient bg
techniques.desc: Light mode linear-gradient from near-white to soft #e8e8ff — never pure white

title: Stripe
subtitle: Financial Infrastructure to Grow Your Revenue
creator: Stripe Design Team

techniques.label: Animated gradient wave hero
techniques.desc: WebGL canvas animation with shifting indigo/purple/teal/coral mesh — static PNG fallback for reduced-motion

techniques.label: Mixed-weight typographic emphasis
techniques.desc: Italic serif mixed with sans in the same headline — typeface contrast as emphasis, not size

techniques.label: Gradient text via background-clip
techniques.desc: background-clip: text; color: transparent — letters carry the brand gradient range

techniques.label: Bento product grid
techniques.desc: Asymmetric large + small cards, each with high-fidelity mini product UI as illustration

techniques.label: Border-only elevation
techniques.desc: Cards use 1px border at 8% opacity — zero box-shadow, elevation via bg tint contrast

techniques.label: Radial particle burst
techniques.desc: HTML5 Canvas 2D, no WebGL. Particles fan from a bottom-centre origin with random angle/maxLen/speed. Opacity eases in (0–15% of travel), holds (15–70%), fades out (70–100%). clearRect + requestAnimationFrame loop — dot tip drawn with ctx.arc at the line endpoint.

techniques.label: Staggered card reveal
techniques.desc: Each card starts at opacity:0 + translateY(22px). setTimeout fires per card at index × staggerMs delay. cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) spring ease-out snaps cards into place.

techniques.label: IntersectionObserver trigger
techniques.desc: Stagger fires once when 20% of the section enters viewport — no scroll listeners, no layout thrash. observe(section) → animateCards() on entry.

techniques.label: Clip-path word reveal
techniques.desc: Headline words wrapped in overflow:hidden divs. Each word slides up from translateY(110%) with animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 0.08s) — the wrapping div clips the motion.

techniques.label: Multi-layer radial gradient bg
techniques.desc: 3 overlapping radial-gradient blobs at different positions/colours layered on a dark base. Each blob at ~30% opacity — stacking creates the painted, glowing look.

techniques.label: Product as marketing medium
techniques.desc: The page IS built like a Gamma presentation — card-based sections, cinematic transitions, content-first layout. The design demonstrates the product by embodying it.

title: Instrument
subtitle: Design Studio — Campaign US Agency of the Year 2026
creator: Instrument Studio

techniques.label: Masonry case study grid
techniques.desc: Mixed portrait and landscape thumbnails in an auto-filling CSS grid — no fixed rows, each image fills its natural aspect ratio. Creates editorial variety without manual placement.

techniques.label: Hover-reveal metadata
techniques.desc: Client name and category tags are hidden by default, revealed on hover via opacity + translateY transition. Keeps the grid visually clean — images speak first.

techniques.label: Category tag system
techniques.desc: #BRAND #MARKETING #PRODUCT as filterable taxonomy. Tags use monospace uppercase at small size — typographic restraint signals design confidence.

techniques.label: Full-bleed image cards
techniques.desc: No card borders, no padding, no rounded corners on the grid items — images bleed edge-to-edge inside their cells. White gutters do all the separation work.

techniques.label: Typeface as identity
techniques.desc: Instrument uses a custom/distinctive display typeface for the studio name — the wordmark IS the brand. No icon, no logomark.

techniques.label: Display serif at hero scale
techniques.desc: Large transitional serif sets the headline at magazine-cover scale — financial product speaking in editorial cadence. Sans handles body copy.

techniques.label: Wireframe isometric illustration
techniques.desc: Two stacked cubes drawn as a single-weight lime line — no fill, no shading. Stand-in for the deposit vault, concept-first.

techniques.label: Bordered-vs-filled CTA pair
techniques.desc: Identical pill geometry; only the fill swaps. Outlined Log In + filled Sign Up — primary/secondary hierarchy in one shape language.

techniques.label: Single-accent reduction
techniques.desc: Whole page lives on black + white text + one lime. Buttons, illustration, and wordmark all share the same hue — colour as constraint.

techniques.label: Editorial promo split
techniques.desc: Headline left, illustration right — no cards, no backgrounds, no scaffolding. Whitespace and typographic scale carry the composition.

techniques.label: Two-tone split layout
techniques.desc: Page bisected vertically — cool azure left for the swap product, soft pink right for the wallet. Two products, one surface, each panel keeping its own colour identity.

techniques.label: Headlines in section accent
techniques.desc: Explore. Swap. Repeat. in cyan. Simple. Safe. Secure. in magenta. Type itself carries the brand hue, not just buttons — every word on a panel matches the panel.

techniques.label: Three-beat triplet headlines
techniques.desc: Both sides use period-separated triplets in the same syntax. A brand cadence built into the headline pattern — repeated structure as recall device.

techniques.label: Token rows as illustration
techniques.desc: Live-styled price rows (Ethereum $2,300.15 +0.59%) with real logos and colour-coded change. The product UI doubles as the marketing graphic — no separate hero illustration needed.

techniques.label: Tinted action-tile grid
techniques.desc: Wallet preview shows four pill action tiles (card, send, receive, scan), each with a tinted bg matching its icon hue. Adds texture without breaking the soft-pastel palette.

title: Harvey
subtitle: AI Platform for Legal Work
creator: Harvey AI
style: Dark Editorial Legal SaaS — Product Accordion

techniques.label: Active-section accordion
techniques.desc: Vertical capability list (Client engagement, Due diligence, Drafting, Research, Negotiation) where the open one expands to show body copy + paired product screen on the right; siblings collapse to a title row. One-at-a-time disclosure used as section navigation.

techniques.label: Real product UI as illustration
techniques.desc: Vault / Change of Control Analysis screen docks right of the active section — Filter / Add file / Column builder chips, file table with Yes/No provision pills. Marketing visual = product surface itself, no commissioned mock.

techniques.label: Whisper-grey title hierarchy
techniques.desc: Inactive section titles fade to mid-grey on near-black; only the active one promotes to white. Identical weight and size across all five — hierarchy carried purely through value contrast.

techniques.label: Tonal inset, no border
techniques.desc: Right-side product card sits on a barely-lighter grey rectangle whose edge is a soft tonal step, not a stroke. Window-without-card — depth without chrome.

techniques.label: Persistent Ask Harvey pill
techniques.desc: Bottom-right floating pill (serif H mark + 'Ask Harvey' label) stays anchored across sections. Brand AI surface as page chrome rather than a help-widget afterthought.
